__comment: Override of Supplementaries. Upstream is three minecraft:bamboo in a vertical column, identical to mcwwindows:bamboo_shutter, so only one of the two could be crafted. The flute is changed rather than the shutter because every Macaw's shutter is three of its material stacked vertically -- breaking that pattern for bamboo alone would be the more confusing change, and the flute is a one-off item players look up once. The supplementaries:flag condition is preserved verbatim so the mod's own config toggle still governs it. Same materials, same count.
